{"id":"urn:uuid:11719cf0-53bf-453c-a6ae-5fc86a6ff8bc","type":["VerifiableCredential"],"issuer":"did:hedera:mainnet:9KbeSVUgUdXTohwwaC8ijAALnr2aioQn3AqE5r5J7wzF_0.0.10379702","issuanceDate":"2026-03-22T11:38:58.866Z","@context":["https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1","ipfs://QmdHHoBCCSX3L2SD1ztdBfw9d3AYGWqYnVaZAN4Z5n9a3A"],"credentialSubject":[{"vvb_vr_key_project_information":{"projectTitle":"PoA GS11815- Electric Cooking Program by ATEC – Electric Cooking Program in Bangladesh by ATEC-VPA02","gsId":"11815","verificationReportVersion":"2.0","verificationReportCompletionDate":"26/02/2026","monitoringPeriodNumberAndDuration":"MP2 Partial verification (01/12/2023 – 27/08/2024 including both dates)","monitoringReportSchemaVersion":"MR Report schema: Version 2 Dated – 30/11/2025","cme":"ATEC Australia-International Pty Ltd","projectRepresentatives":["Ben Jeffreys"],"hostCountry":"Bangladesh","appliedMethodologiesAndStandardizedBaselines":["Methodology for Metered & Measured Energy Cooking Devices, Version 1.1"],"activityRequirementsApplied":["Community Services Activities","Renewable Energy Activities","Land Use and Forestry Activities/Risks & Capacities","N/A"],"mandatorySectoralScopes":["Sectoral Scope 03: Energy demand"],"productRequirementsApplied":["GHG Emissions Reduction & Sequestration","Renewable Energy Label","N/A"],"emissionReductionsPeriod":"01/12/2023 – 27/08/2024","amountsAchieved":"1667","vvbName":"Earthood Services Limited","vvbIdOrCode":"E-0066","approverName":"Dr. Kaviraj Singh","approverPosition":"Executive Director & CEO"},"purposeOfVpa":"The implemented VPA “Electric Cooking Program in Bangladesh by ATEC – VPA02” under the PoA “Electric Cooking Program by ATEC”, developed by ATEC Australia-International Pty Ltd (ATEC), aims to replace highly polluting non-renewable and fossil fuels used for cooking by households in the target areas. This is achieved through distribution and installation of ATEC PAYGO-enabled eCook induction cookstoves with integrated GSM communication and Internet of Things (IoT) functionality that records stove location and electricity consumption. The target end-users are households relying on inefficient baseline stoves but having grid access. The assessment team noted that the project has been implemented in Bangladesh, with 3,254 eCook units distributed during 2022–2024, resulting in estimated greenhouse gas emission reductions of 1,667 tCO2e during the 270-day partial verification period (01/12/2023–27/08/2024).","scopeOfVerification":"The verification was conducted under the Gold Standard Digital Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (DMRV) Pilot Programme (Version 0.1) to provide an independent and objective assessment of the greenhouse gas emission reductions generated through the digitally monitored Electric Cooking Program in Bangladesh by ATEC – VPA02. The scope covered assessment of the DMRV system architecture, data integrity, and algorithm accuracy used for quantifying emission reductions through the Guardian platform, including evaluation of IoT devices, GSM-based data transmission, cloud storage and synchronization, coded calculation logic, completeness and duplication checks, outlier checks, accuracy of applied parameters, and the data management, privacy, and quality assurance procedures implemented by ATEC. No physical site visit was undertaken for this partial verification; the verification was carried out remotely based on digital access to system data, documentation, and recorded evidence.","verificationProcess":"The verification was based on review of the approved methodology “Methodology for Metered and Measured Energy Cooking Devices, Version 1.1”, the registered VPA-DD and monitoring plan, the Gold Standard for the Global Goals Principles and Requirements Version 2.1, and the DMRV Programme – VVB Requirements (v0.1) and other relevant digital verification guidance. Activities undertaken included desk-based review of the DMRV architecture and documentation; algorithm and code review with testing of selected modules and representative input-output samples; data integrity and accuracy checks covering completeness of uploaded IoT data, duplicate record detection, timestamp validation, and automated outlier flagging; assessment of data cleaning, storage, and security systems; cross-verification of sample device consumption data against Guardian outputs; review of data privacy and security mechanisms including access control, encryption, and storage protocols; interviews with key personnel including the CME’s digital monitoring team and local project implementers; review of one recorded household user interview; and review of training and grievance-handling procedures.","conclusion":"Based on the outcome of the verification process for the project activity “Electric Cooking Program in Bangladesh by ATEC – VPA02” under the Program of Activities “Electric Cooking Program by ATEC” for the monitoring period 01/12/2023 – 27/08/2024 (inclusive of both dates), Earthood Services Limited confirms that the implementation of the referenced registered VPA complies with the applicable requirements of the Gold Standard for the Global Goals and the Gold Standard DMRV Pilot Programme (Version 0.1). The greenhouse gas emission reductions were determined in accordance with the approved methodology “Methodology for Metered & Measured Energy Cooking Devices, Version 1.1”. As this is a partial verification, only the parameters monitored through the digital system were assessed, while the remaining monitoring plan elements will be verified during complete verification. Earthood is therefore able to certify that the verified greenhouse gas emission reductions achieved during this monitoring period amount to 1,667 tCO2e.","verificationTeamMembers":"Rahul Dev Gautam (Team Leader and Technical Area Expert (TA 3.1 – Energy Efficiency), GS approved auditor; also Validator/Verifier), Treeshali Sharma (Digital Systems Specialist – Key Expertise: Data Management, DMRV & AI Analytics), Ananya Mishra (Sensor Technology Specialist), and Akkas Aki (Local Expert – Bangladesh).","technicalReviewersAndApprovers":"Sushant Vashisht (Technical Reviewer; TA Expert to TR (TA 3.1)) and Dr. Kaviraj Singh (Approver).","deskReviewPlanning":"The verification was performed primarily as a desk-based digital assessment of the documentation and datasets made available through the Guardian digital monitoring system and supplementary project records. The review was conducted using dedicated verification protocols and checklists developed in accordance with the Gold Standard DMRV Pilot Programme (Version 0.1). The desk review focused on completeness, traceability, and consistency of information provided by the Coordinating and Managing Entity, and independent data-trace checks were performed to verify integrity of the uploaded datasets and their alignment with the applied methodology.","onSiteInspection":"No physical site visit was undertaken for this partial verification. The assessment team conducted remote interviews, and a complete site visit will be conducted during the stage of complete verification.","remoteAuditIfApplicable":"No formal remote audit was undertaken for this partial verification. However, the VVB conducted a limited remote verification to assess functional implementation, end-user awareness, and project-level management arrangements. This included a remote interview with ATEC’s project implementation team, review of a recorded end-user interview confirming installation and operation of the eCook induction stove, and review of a screen recording of the Ecook mobile application demonstrating real-time tracking of electricity consumption and payment synchronization.","samplingApproach":"No sampling was required or applied for this partial verification.
